subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Decision Hygiene
description: A quick win: understand Decision Hygiene.

hook.text: Two judges see the same case, same facts. One gives 5 years, the other gives 12. This gap is noise.

buildup.text: Kahneman's 'Noise' shows that variability in human judgment is far larger than people realize.

discovery.text: Decision hygiene: structured processes that reduce noise without needing to identify the specific bias.

twist.text: You don't need to fix each bias individually. Standardizing the process reduces all biases at once.

climax.text: Checklists, rubrics, and independent assessments before discussion cut noise dramatically.

punchline.text: Fix the process, not the person.

quiz.question: What is the goal of decision hygiene?
options: Reduce variability and noise in decisions through structure

details.summary: Decision hygiene applies structured procedures to reduce noise and bias in judgments, analogous to how sanitation prevents disease. Techniques include independent assessment, structured interviews, and statistical aggregation that protect decisions from predictable errors.
details.whyItMatters: Organizations make thousands of decisions daily, and these decisions are contaminated by noise and bias that no one detects without measurement. Decision hygiene systematically reduces these errors at the organizational level.
takeaways: Decision hygiene reduces judgment errors through systematic procedures
Independent assessments before discussion prevent anchoring and groupthink
Statistical aggregation of multiple judgments outperforms individual experts

faq.question: What are practical decision hygiene techniques?
faq.answer: Have evaluators make independent assessments before group discussion. Use structured criteria rather than holistic impressions. Aggregate multiple judgments statistically. Delay intuitive conclusions until after systematic analysis.

faq.question: How is decision hygiene different from debiasing?
faq.answer: Debiasing tries to fix individual thinking. Decision hygiene redesigns the decision process so that individual biases and noise are neutralized by the structure itself. It works even when individuals remain biased because the process corrects them.
